dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetric linear narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity pixel distribution across the visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, high-contrast dark rectangular feature is positioned on the dorsal midline posterior to the blowhole region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a distinct, dark rectangular mark (likely a tracking tag or artificial marker) on the anterior dorsal midline.
other_distinctive_markers: The black rectangular anomaly is highly unique and presents a sharp contrast against the white epidermal baseline.
